feedback: Keep sf2 as the categorical age-group STRATIFIER. Keep the inclusion decision, publication form, one-Study structure, primary family, purposes, and principal findings. Split du1 by collection role. Record the socioeconomic questionnaire that was adapted and administered for this investigation as CURRENT_STUDY_COLLECTION, with iu1 and its applicable Epi Info use in DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY. Keep reused NESTT medical, ophthalmic, low-vision, visual-acuity, and prevalence data as PRIOR_RESEARCH_COLLECTION and keep their instrument or method uses in SOURCE_STUDY_ACTIVITY. Keep the contemporaneous eye-care-system survey as a separate prior-research source. Split du4, du5, and du6 because each DataUse must identify one source: separate the 2011 Census, 2014 mid-year population estimates, selected WHO disability weights, alternative disability-weight sources, income and wage statistics, value-of-statistical-life input, GDP deflator, exchange rate, and external unit-cost sources. Add the reported 450 outpatients who supplied travel-cost data as a distinct population and COMPLETED sample linked to the eye-care-system source; also represent the three private companies that supplied ophthalmic-drug prices as a separate unit-cost source. Replace the study-wide Stata sw2 with part-scoped uses for part1 survey analysis and part3 burden or sensitivity calculations. Add an Administration for the standardized visual-acuity measurement, with the assessor measurement and outside-household setting reported by the source. Add the limitation that individual income was not collected, which prevented direct estimation of income loss by vision category. Add the reported assumptions that market wages approximate the opportunity cost of the employment gap and that private-sector prices, including profit, approximate societal opportunity costs.

Add the omitted central input data. Create separate part-scoped DataUse records for the historical ABJHI EQ-5D-5L pre-surgery data and one-year post-surgery data used in Parts 1 and 2. Use origin ROUTINE_SERVICE_COLLECTION and level AGGREGATE_ESTIMATE; state that these data supplied the displayed distributions and change patterns. Delete purpose pur2, IMPLEMENTATION_EVALUATION. If part0 remains a substantive part, code its supported empirical approaches from the piloted closed- and open-ended checklist process, or record the missing component through a NOT_REPORTED Gap instead of an invalid Design value. Revise du1 so that it does not claim QUALITATIVE_MATERIAL or a specific patient-feedback data source that the article does not report; use a source-faithful label for the clinic pilot and level NOT_REPORTED unless more exact evidence is available.

Replace `mu1` as the representation of the regression model itself. Create part-scoped `ModelUse` items for the separately fitted THA and TKA mixed-effects logistic regression models. Use context `DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY`, function `STATISTICAL_ESTIMATION`, and analytic role `PRIMARY_REPORTED`; preserve the hospital random intercept, the stated fixed adjustment variables, and the separate PNB-utilization and secondary-outcome applications in the source-faithful labels or descriptions. Keep PAR, complete-case analysis, and the chi-square test as MethodUse items. Retain the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, one-Study structure, primary family, purposes, and reported status. Repair the record as follows. (1) Record the important age/version mismatch in Table 1: 11 participants aged 8–12 completed the teen self-report, and 8 participants aged 13–17 completed the child self-report; age was missing for 5 child-version and 3 teen-version completers. Add exact COMPLETED subgroup Samples or equivalent sample details. Add a SourceConflict that preserves the stated child 8–12 and teen 13–17/18 age-version descriptions from Methods and the observed cross-version counts in Table 1. This fact affects which populations were used to validate each version. (2) Add separate part1 InstrumentUse records for both Chichewa versions as CONTENT_TEST_OBJECT and DEVELOPMENT_OBJECT. Cognitive interviews tested item understanding, and participant suggestions led to iterative wording revision; TRANSLATION_TARGET alone does not represent these main roles. Update outcome o1 and relevant findings to link these uses. (3) Replace combined iu7 with two exact InstrumentUse records: the Chichewa (Malawi) PedsQL 4.0 GCS child self-report and teen self-report, each used as a MEASUREMENT_PROPERTY_TEST_OBJECT in part3. Update o3 to link both exact variants plus the two EQ-5D-Y comparators. (4) Add SAMPLING MethodUse records for the convenience sample from one primary school in part1 and the convenience sample from five schools and the Queen Elizabeth Central Hospital outpatient department in part2. (5) Set recall_period to null or not reported in a1, a3, and a4. The article does not report “past one month”; this value was imported from outside the supplied source. (6) Extend f6 or add a finding for the stated gender exception: the child-version Social Functioning score differed by gender (mean difference 11.23, t=2.761, p=0.007), although the other gender results generally supported discriminant validity. (7) Add the source-reported content-scope limitation or interpretation that cognitive interviews did not identify aspects of health relevant in Chichewa that were absent from the instrument, and that further qualitative investigation of item appropriateness and completeness was needed.

Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, single Study, primary family, design axes, principal results, interpretations, and limitations. Make these local corrections: (1) Delete Purpose p2 (`METHOD_OR_PROTOCOL_QUALITY`). The stated aims concern recall-period interpretation and proxy perspective-taking as content-validity or response-process questions. The authors do not state a separate evaluation of a method or protocol. Keep p1 as rank 1. (2) Revise pop1 to resolve the source inconsistency: the title and abstract call the participants informal carers, but the eligibility criteria permitted paid or unpaid carers. Use a neutral label such as “adult current carers of people living with dementia” and preserve “paid or unpaid” in the inclusion description. Do not assert that all final participants were informal unless participant-level evidence confirms this. Remove Australia from pop2 because the source specifies the carers’ residence, not the care recipients’ residence. (3) Revise iu2 so that the instrument identity is the source instrument, `EQ-HWB`, with a note that the study used three positively worded items: feeling accepted by others, feeling good about themselves, and doing the things they wanted to do. Do not treat this item bundle as a separate registry instrument. Keep `registry_id` empty pending exact variant review. (4) Correct td1. The article does not report that the EQ-HWB-9 always preceded the three additional items or that all 12 items had a fixed sequential order. It only states that carers completed these items with think-aloud and prompts, and that the proxy-perspective question followed questionnaire completion. Remove the invented block and order details. Also restrict the statement about five response options to the nine EQ-HWB-9 items because the article does not specify the response-option count for the three additional items. (5) Remove pu1 as a `GOVERNING_STUDY_PROTOCOL`. The study-specific topic guide is reported as an interview guide, not as the protocol that governed the whole study. Retain it as evidence for the cognitive-interview method and interviewer assistance. (6) Add a REDCap SoftwareUse with function `DATA_COLLECTION`, or replace the current sole function, because REDCap directly collected participants’ contact information. A separate `DATA_MANAGEMENT` use can remain if its storage role is also represented. (7) Qualify f5. All carers compared recent behavior with earlier behavior, but the source does not say that all carers also used personality traits, idiosyncrasies, and mannerisms. Separate these statements or change the second claim to “carers also referred to.”

Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol support, publication form, single Study, primary family, status, and current Study structure. Add OUTCOME_DESCRIPTION as a rank-2 purpose because the stated aims include pooled HRQoL values, affected dimensions, subgroup differences, and predictors. Add a QUALITY_CONTROL MethodUse for the independent risk-of-bias assessments by two reviewers and resolution by discussion or a third researcher. In f3, replace each denominator of "104 studies" with "participants represented in 104 contributing studies; exact participant denominator not reported" because 51%, 46%, 42%, 37%, and 21% are pooled participant prevalences, not percentages of studies. Extend f10 with the reported source-study administration results: face-to-face interview, 44 studies (23.5%), and digital administration, 43 studies (23%); also add the UK value set, 20 studies, and the US value set, 12 studies. Add a source-reported Gap for missing evidence on vaccination status, testing and early diagnosis, treatment adherence, hospitalization, and ICU admission, together with the stated need for longitudinal studies. Add a DATASET Product for the datasets used or analyzed in the review and record that they are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request. Record the explicit statement that the review protocol was not registered through an UNMODELED_ASPECT Gap until the ontology supports protocol-registration status.

Delete SourceConflict conf1. Appendix Table A2 occurs once; the later full-cohort table is Table 2 with the distinct identifier cancers-16-01952-t002. Add MethodUse records for the Kolmogorov–Smirnov test and Shapiro–Wilk test, each with DIRECT_CURRENT_ACTIVITY and QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS. Add the Section 4.2 interpretation that different or additional assessment times and breast-cancer-specific PROMs may improve detection and interpretation of change. Add separate MethodUse records for the chi-square tests and Mann–Whitney U tests used in the non-response analysis, with function QUANTITATIVE_ANALYSIS. Revise adm2–adm4 and the TaskDesign wording to state the exact recall instruction: participants reported what they remembered reporting on the EQ-5D-3L at the earlier assessment; do not describe this only as a fresh assessment of recalled health. Make three local corrections. First, in adm2 and adm3, set instrument_language and interview_language to null or NOT_REPORTED. The article states that people who speak a language other than English were not represented, but it does not directly report the interview or displayed-instrument language. Second, remove thematic saturation from td1.stopping_rule because the decision to stop further interviews is a study sampling or quality-control procedure, not an interview-task stopping rule. Add a direct-current-activity MethodUse for assessment of data and thematic saturation across coding rounds, with QUALITY_CONTROL as its function, and state that no further interviews were conducted after round three because no new codes emerged. Third, add the omitted recruitment method details: service providers were invited by email through the study-team network and snowball referral; caregivers were recontacted from eligible Australian P-MIC participants who had agreed to future research; and adolescents were approached through their caregivers. Keep the present purposive-sampling record and the other scientific content unchanged.

Do not state that every model or the source survey had fewer than 100 respondents because the parent model had 179 and the source survey had 631 completers. Revise Finding f4. Retain the authors’ statement that EQ-5D-5L did not significantly improve discrimination, but add the horizon-specific Table 2 estimates: change in C-index 0.002 (95% CI 0.001–0.004) at 30 days, 0.013 (95% CI 0.008–0.021) at 180 days, and 0.004 (95% CI 0.001–0.007) at 360 days. Add a SourceConflict between the narrative claim of no significant improvement and the Table 2 confidence intervals, which exclude zero. Also revise Administration a1 to distinguish general survey-return timing from primary-model timing: responses arrived 16–200 days after discharge, but the primary analysis used weekly landmarks from days 23–60 and included a participant only after PROM completion and while event-free. No change is needed to inclusion, EuroQol support, publication form, Study unit, primary family, instruments, models, or principal interpretation.

Keep the inclusion decision, EuroQol-support assessment, Study unit, primary family, instrument roles, main findings, and administration SourceConflict. Make these local corrections: (1) add the omitted structural-validity procedures: Kaiser–Meyer–Olkin and Bartlett suitability tests, parallel analysis, oblique Promax rotation, diagonally weighted least-squares CFA estimation, modification-index inspection with three correlated residual pairs, and 1,000-bootstrap confidence intervals; (2) add the reported qualification that FT1 and FT8 had PCA communalities below 0.5, that FT1 and FT2 had the lowest CFA loadings, and that the authors considered FT1 and FT2 to fit the model poorly but retained the two-factor structure because overall fit was good; (3) represent scale-level floor and ceiling as two distinct 0% aggregate values instead of one value that ambiguously supports both outcomes; (4) record a SourceConflict for the baseline mean denominator: the distributional-results text concerns 300 baseline participants, while Table 6 presents the same baseline mean in a combined paired-sample row labeled n=298; do not silently select one denominator; and (5) revise limitation l2 to remove the added claim that the setting may limit generalizability. The authors explicitly state that the insured public-hospital setting may explain the absence of worst possible scores, but they do not explicitly label this as a generalizability limitation.

Expand Concept c1, or add four linked Concept records, to preserve the central definitions: variability is intrinsic variation between individual cases; heterogeneity is variation in distributional properties between subgroups; statistical uncertainty results from sample-to-population inference and concerns bias and precision; and methodological variation results from choices in elicitation, administration, data collection, and analysis. Keep the disposition, publication form, Study unit, primary family, and other items unchanged.
